blocks.tamil_translation: completely, bear witness (with the heart and the tongue) that there is no god other than Allah (worthy of being obeyed and worshipped) and that Muhammad ﷺ is His servant and Messenger, establish Salah, and give Zakat. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيّاً أَتَي النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: دُلَّنِي عَلَي عَمَلٍ إِذَا عَمِلْتُهُ دَخَلْتُ الْجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: تَعْبُدُ اللهَ لَا تُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً، وَتُقِيمُ الصَّلَاةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ، وَتُؤَدِّي الزَّكَاةَ الْمَفْرُوضَةَ، وَتَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ، قَالَ: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَا أَزِيدُ عَلَي هذَا، فَلَمَّا وَلَّي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَي رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَي هذَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب وجوب الزكاة رقم:١٣٩٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, “A villager came into the presence of the beloved Prophet ﷺ and asked, “O Messenger of Allah, teach me a deed that will make me enter Jannah!’ He said, “Worship Allah! Do not associate anyone as a partner with Him! Establish the Fard Salahs! Pay the obligatory Zakat! Fast in the month of Ramadan!’ The villager said, “By Him in Whose hand is my life! (I will do the deeds you have mentioned just as you said) I will not add anything to these,” and then turned and went away. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever wishes to see a person of Jannah, let him look at this man.’

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ ﵁ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَي رَسُولِ اللهِ
